snippet.title: Basketball Career Management on PC | Hoop Dynasty Demo Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Create your player. Shape your build. Meet your career rival. Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend is a single-player PC basketball career RPG and management simulation.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4968700/Hoop_Dynasty_Rise_of_a_Legend/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic_video&utm_campaign=demo_launch_20261006&utm_content=trailer_r5

The free Steam demo launches October 6. Hoop Dynasty joins Steam Next Fest October 19–26.

Watch real gameplay from the College journey: distribute your build points, choose your College and agree on a development plan, meet your career rival, train, balance life off the court, earn your coach’s trust and propose a starting five. Make possession decisions in the live 2D Match Center, see the Hot/Cold system in action, and answer a national-team call-up.

Every choice is part of your player’s career. This is basketball career management on Windows PC, with RPG conversations, player development and a basketball world that moves around you. The trailer shows the College path; College, International and Pro are the career paths planned for the full game.

Join the official Discord for updates and feedback: https://discord.gg/sEmzpd8X3J
Official website: https://hoopdynasty.info/

#HoopDynasty #BasketballGame #PCGaming
